# Appeal of Denied Prior Authorization — Request for Reconsideration

**Date:** [Date of this letter]

**To:** Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield
[Appeal address printed on my denial letter]

**From:** Rowan Ellison
[My mailing address]
[My phone number]

---

**RE: Appeal of adverse benefit determination dated 2026-08-04**
**Member:** Rowan Ellison
**Member ID:** W869972825
**Reference number:** POC-CE2E11F72D-11045
**Service denied:** Rotator cuff repair, CPT 29827
**Governing policy:** Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Musculoskeletal – Joint Surgery (https://guidelines.carelonmedicalbenefitsmanagement.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/PDF-Joint-Surgery-2025-11-15.pdf)

---

## What I am asking for

I am appealing the denial of prior authorization for rotator cuff repair (CPT 29827), issued by Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield on 2026-08-04 under reference number POC-CE2E11F72D-11045. The notice states that the documentation submitted was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity. I am asking the plan to reconsider that decision and approve the procedure.

My surgeon, Dr. Reyes, MD (orthopedic surgery), has documented that this surgery is needed. Below I set out the plan's own published criteria, in the plan's own words, alongside what my medical records show. I believe the records already in the plan's hands address each of these points, and I am resubmitting them with this appeal.

This appeal is being submitted within the timeframe stated in my denial notice, which says my appeal must be received within 180 days of the date of the notice, by **2027-01-31**. I am sending it to the appeal address printed on my denial letter. I understand I may also contact Anthem online at anthem.com or through the Sydney Health app, or by phone at the number on the back of my ID card.

---

## The plan's criteria and what my records show

### 1. Tobacco and nicotine

The policy states:

> "For primary rotator cuff repair, adherence to a tobacco cessation program resulting in abstinence from tobacco and nicotine products for at least 6 weeks prior to surgery is strongly recommended."

My records state that I am a non-smoker.

### 2. The pathway that applies to my tear

The policy sets out separate pathways. It states:

> "Rotator cuff repair is considered medically necessary for a chronic or degenerative full thickness tear when ALL the following criteria are met:"

That sentence ends in a colon and introduces a list of conditions that I have not been given in full, so I cannot address every item on it individually. I would ask the plan to identify precisely which criteria it applied to my request and which one it found unmet.

Of the criteria I do have, the policy states:

> "Gradual onset of shoulder pain in the absence of a significant traumatic event within the preceding 3 months"

My records document 9 months of progressive shoulder pain, unrelieved by rest. No traumatic event is recorded. For completeness, the policy's acute pathway requires "Traumatic injury within the preceding 3 months with no preexisting shoulder pain (For traumatic injuries that occurred more than 3 months ago, see chronic or degenerative full thickness tear)" — which confirms that my gradual, 9-month presentation belongs in the chronic or degenerative pathway, not the acute one. The policy also contains a separate pathway that begins "Rotator cuff repair is considered medically necessary for a partial thickness tear when ALL the following criteria are met:" and includes "Symptoms are present for at least 3 months." My MRI shows a full-thickness tear, so I understand the partial-thickness pathway is not the one that applies; even so, my symptoms have been present for 9 months.

### 3. Pain and effect on daily activities

The policy states:

> "Pain ≥ 3 on the VAS scale which interferes with age-appropriate activities of daily living"

My records document 9 months of progressive pain that rest does not relieve, and that I cannot lift my arm above shoulder height or sleep on the affected side. My exam is documented as showing positive provocative testing on the affected side, with range of motion limited by pain. [Recorded VAS pain score from my chart, if documented — to be supplied by my provider's office.] I would ask the reviewer to look at the pain scores recorded in my treating records rather than treating this item as unaddressed.

### 4. Imaging

The policy states:

> "Recent advanced imaging confirms features of a degenerative full thickness tear"

and

> "Imaging report. The provider shall submit a detailed imaging report for studies obtained within the past 12 months. In the absence of a detailed report, the provider may submit a report from an independent radiologist."

I had an MRI of the shoulder on 2026-05-27 — well within the past 12 months — which showed a full-thickness supraspinatus tear measuring 1.8 cm with grade 2 fatty atrophy. The full MRI report is enclosed with this appeal. [Copy of the 2026-05-27 MRI report to be enclosed.] If the plan considers the report it received to be insufficiently detailed, I ask that it say so specifically, so that my provider can supply what is missing rather than have the request denied for reasons I cannot identify.

### 5. Conservative management

The policy states:

> "Conservative management1 must include a combination of strategies to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and correct underlying dysfunction, including physical therapy AND at least ONE complementary conservative treatment strategy."

It also states:

> "Failure of at least 6 weeks of conservative management"

and

> "Patient has completed a full course of conservative management (as defined above) for the current episode of care"

My records document all of the following for this episode of care:

- **Physical therapy:** supervised physical therapy focused on rotator cuff strengthening and scapular mechanics, 10 weeks, from 2026-04-09 to 2026-06-18, with 18 visits completed. This is recorded in my physical therapy discharge note.
- **Complementary treatment — medication:** NSAIDs for 6 months, with inadequate relief.
- **Complementary treatment — injection:** a corticosteroid injection on 2026-04-09, which gave 4 weeks of partial relief.

That is physical therapy plus two complementary treatment strategies, where the policy asks for physical therapy and at least one. The 10-week course of supervised therapy exceeds the six weeks the policy names, and it was completed and discharged. My pain has continued and remains unrelieved by rest.

---

## Why I am asking for a different outcome

The denial says the documentation was incomplete. The records summarized above are dated, specific, and were part of the prior authorization packet: a dated MRI within 12 months with a described tear, a dated and completed course of supervised physical therapy with a visit count and a discharge note, dated medication and injection trials, documented exam findings, documented functional loss, and non-smoker status. Where the plan's published criteria set out a requirement I have been shown, my records speak to it.

I also want to note plainly that several of the criteria I was given end in a colon and introduce lists of further conditions that were not reproduced for me. I am not quoting or characterizing policy language I have not seen. If the plan is relying on a condition within one of those lists, I ask that it be identified.

I therefore ask Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield to:

1. Overturn the denial dated 2026-08-04 and authorize rotator cuff repair, CPT 29827; or
2. If the plan maintains the denial, state in writing exactly which criterion in the Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Musculoskeletal – Joint Surgery it found unmet, and exactly which document or finding it considers missing, so that Dr. Reyes can supply it; and
3. Provide me with a copy of the specific clinical criteria used in this review and the credentials of the reviewer who made the determination.

Please send the decision on this appeal to me in writing at the address above, and to Dr. Reyes.

Thank you for taking a careful second look at this.

Sincerely,

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
**Rowan Ellison**
Member ID: W869972825
[My mailing address]

- Office notes from Dr. Reyes, MD
- [Any other records my provider's office is enclosing]
